responsibility: This file implements GCC’s pointer and object-size query engine used by diagnostics and optimization code to reason about what object a pointer may refer to, what offsets into that object are possible, and how large the referenced region can be. It follows SSA def-use chains through built-ins, pointer arithmetic, PHIs, arrays, fields, and allocation functions, consults range information, caches access_ref results in pointer_query, and provides helpers such as compute_objsize, field_at_offset, array_elt_at_offset, and printable array-type construction. Its role is middle-end object/reference analysis infrastructure for bounds, string, and access checking logic.
same_name_distinction: Implements the pointer-query engine declared in pointer-query.h: the out-of-line SSA/object-size analysis logic, cache use, and helper algorithms such as compute_objsize, field_at_offset, array_elt_at_offset, and printable array-type construction.
